messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **federal holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, the adjacent weekend days give you a three‑day break; if it falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the following Monday is usually observed, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-----------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 (observed) | **Jan 1–3** | 2023 New Year’s Day falls on a Sunday, so the observed holiday is Monday Jan 2. |
| Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** | Not a federal holiday, but observed in many provinces. |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday is a federal holiday; Easter Monday is *not* a federal holiday. |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday. |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 (observed) | **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day falls on a Saturday, so the observed holiday is Monday Jul 3. |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** | First Monday in September. |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** | First Monday in October. |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 (observed) | **Nov 11–13** | Observed on Monday when it falls on a Saturday. |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** | First day of the holiday season. |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | – | Not a long weekend (falls on a Tuesday). |

### Quick Summary of Long‑Weekend Dates (2023)

- **Jan 1–3** (New Year’s Day)  
- **Feb 18–20** (Family Day in most provinces)  
- **Apr 7–9** (Good Friday)  
- **May 20–22** (Victoria Day)  
- **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day)  
- **Sep 2–4** (Labour Day)  
- **Oct 7–9** (Thanksgiving)  
- **Nov 11–13** (Remembrance Day)  
- **Dec 23–25** (Christmas Day)

> **Tip for your app:** If you want to support provincial variations (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), you’ll need to pull province‑specific holiday data. The table above covers the federal holidays that generate long weekends across the country.
